title: The Corn Maze Chalkboard
story: Hilltop Orchard's corn maze has four ways in: two gates, the old barn door, and a gap beside the scarecrow. Four friends each took a different one and chose a different snack at the exit. The farmer chalked their times on the board, and then a squall washed it clean. Jonah, who keeps his ferry on time to the minute, had left his watch at home. Who went in where, with which snack, and how fast?

texts: The friend who went in by the scarecrow finished faster than the friend who went in by the barn door.
Quinn did not choose the kettle corn.
The friend who went in by the barn door finished the maze in either 20 minutes or 30 minutes.
The friend who went in by the north gate chose neither the kettle corn nor the donut.
Of the friend who went in by the south gate and the friend who took 25 minutes, one chose the donut and the other chose the kettle corn.
The friend who took 25 minutes chose either the donut or the candy apple.
The friend who took 30 minutes is either Quinn or Jonah.
The friend who chose the candy apple finished the maze in either 30 minutes or 35 minutes.
Of the friend who took 20 minutes and the friend who took 35 minutes, one is Quinn and the other is Faye.
